BaseId.description: Identifies a warm base: the substrate a unit's home is cloned from.

DbName.description: A database name Nodal created and may therefore drop.

Digest.description:
A content digest, lowercase hex. The algorithm is the fingerprint module's
choice; the model only fixes the form.

EnvId.description:
Identifies one materialisation of a unit. A unit re-materialised after reclaim
gets a new environment, not a new unit.

EnvState.description: Whether an environment exists on disk and whether anything is running in it.

oneOf.description: Recorded but not materialised, or reclaimed.

HostName.description: The name of a host a unit can live on.

Ports.description: The ports allocated to an environment, by the name the recipe gave them.

SchemaFp.description: The key a database template is stored under.

Timestamp.description: A UTC instant, serialised as an RFC 3339 string.

UnitId.description: Identifies a `WorkUnit`. Stable for the life of the work, across machines.

WorkspaceFp.description: The key a warm base is stored under.

description:
One home directory, its services and how current it is.

`ws_fp_materialized` and `schema_fp_materialized` are what was installed here, not
what the tree now asks for: staleness is the difference between the two, computed
when it matters. Whether the tree is dirty is never stored.

attempt.description: Which materialisation of that unit this is, counting from one.

base_id.description: The base the home was cloned from, when it was cloned from one.

db_name.description: The per-unit database, when the stack has one.

fixed_port.description: A port the project pins and only one environment may hold at a time.

host.description: The host that holds the writable copy.

managed.description:
False for a directory adopted in place, which Nodal did not create and will
never remove.

ports.description: Ports allocated from the project's block.

schema_fp_materialized.description: The schema fingerprint actually present in the database here.

state.description: Whether the home exists and whether anything runs in it.

unit_id.description: The unit this is a materialisation of.

ws_fp_materialized.description: The workspace fingerprint actually installed here.

title: Environment
